perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

enhanced.name: Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Under Pressure
enhanced.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

enhanced.name: Slideways
enhanced.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Backup Plan
enhanced.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for an improved short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

enhanced.name: High-Impact Reserves
enhanced.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Action
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Controlled Burst
enhanced.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

enhanced.name: Rangefinder
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification, and improves handling. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Kickstart
enhanced.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for an improved duration.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

enhanced.name: Voltshot
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

flavor: Sworn into faithful service to the Queen, the Techeuns of the Reef have long protected the secrets of the Awoken.
